primaryTarget: binary: NEXUS_SELECTOR uniquely best (1) vs RESOURCE_PRESERVING_V1 uniquely best (0); other rows excluded

multinomialDiagnostic.metric: CAL soft-target cross-entropy over available policies
multinomialDiagnostic.purpose: information measurement only; not a router candidate

fieldSelection.where: DEV only, 2 folds by recordHash first hex digit parity
fieldSelection.usableIf: status AVAILABLE on every DEV and CAL row (no imputation)
fieldSelection.structuralRejectIf: field is identical to a CORE feature, or to the CORE identity threatened - uncovered

bootstrap.statistic: paired AUROC delta over CAL rows

classification.C: a diagnostic group (objective/spatial/temporal) is material and its delta exceeds the risk delta
classification.A: accepted risk fields non-empty and CORE+ACCEPTED delta material
classification.B: risk delta CI lower > 0 but below materiality, or accepted fields exist but CI includes zero
classification.D: no group or risk delta with CI lower > 0

enrichedContractRule: create SENTINEL_DEPLOYABLE_FEATURE_CONTRACT_V1_1 only if accepted fields exist AND CAL delta CI lower > 0

forensics.router: frozen Stage 3F.6-T router (weights from its evaluation freeze), threshold 0, fallback RESOURCE_PRESERVING_V1
forensics.error: selected policy outside the minimum-regret best set
forensics.thresholds: medians and novelty quantiles computed on DEV / CAL before any error is counted
